entries.name: Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row
entries.reason: Own drawn frames on The half-kneeling chain (spine 24.00, neck 9.00, thigh 22.06, shin 22.49 exact) with the drawn high pulley answering how the equipment is used. Full notes and open questions in the daily review.
entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a kneeling single-arm high pulley ro

frames.caption: Half-kneel facing the high cable with the hips and shoulders square.
Reach the working arm long from the square base.
Drive the elbow down and back toward the ribs.
Let the shoulder blade finish the pull at the ribs.
Return to the full reach slowly with the elbow leading.
